All 5 sampler/DC axes exhausted (dc_relax 0.5/1.0, init_t 0.7/0.4/0.2, n_cg 5/20/60, NFE 8/16, eta 1.0/0.5): recon pinned ~7.4 dB below the 128-view sparse-FBP floor (PSNR36.32/RMSE0.0052), hr=0 throughout. Honest below-baseline finding for the UNconstrained (Mayo-fallback) wavelet prior on sparse breast. Banking the confirmation toward the required 20 valid iters.
